allowHttpFill.title: Allow autofill on HTTP sites
allowHttpFill.description: Allow filling passwords on unencrypted HTTP pages.

copyTotp.title: Copy TOTP after filling
copyTotp.description: After filling a login that has a TOTP, copy the current code to the clipboard.

autofillTotp.title: Autofill TOTP codes
autofillTotp.description: Fill the current TOTP code into a site's authenticator-code field.

cardSecurityCode.title: Card security code
cardSecurityCode.description: Leave the card security code alone (off), fill it, or copy it to the clipboard.
